## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install GSGTestRepo in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure GSGTestRepo package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to GSGTestRepo
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/gsgbills/GSGTestRepo):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/gsgbills/GSGTestRepo.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/gsgbills/GSGTestRepo)

``` sh
$ conda install -c gsgbills GSGTestRepo
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/GSGTestRepo/)

``` sh
$ pip install GSGTestRepo
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/gsgbills/GSGTestRepo)’s
[pages](https://gsgbills.github.io/GSGTestRepo/). Additionally you can
find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/gsgbills/GSGTestRepo) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/GSGTestRepo/) respectively.
